name: Melody Pines Day Camp
description_short: Private day camp in Manchester, NH for children entering grades K–8, with separate girls' and boys' groups by grade. Tuition covers a full day from 7:30am to 5:00pm and includes swimming lessons; only full weeks can be booked.
refund_policy_summary: You must pay a non-refundable, non-transferable deposit for each week at registration. If you cancel before May 1, you get a refund minus the deposit. After May 1, you owe for all reserved weeks. The remaining balance is due by May 15; if it isn't paid by then, your weeks are cancelled and you lose the deposit. Credit card payments carry a 3% surcharge, and returned checks cost $30.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swimming lessons are included in tuition. The camp mentions docks, which it removes in the off-season.

warnings: The deposit amount conflicts: the Pricing section says $65 per child per week, but the FAQ says $50 per week to hold a spot. $65 matches the stated balance math ($425 - $65 = $360).

Registration opens on different days by family type: returning families Feb 1, 2027, previously waitlisted families Feb 2, new families Feb 3. Each session's registration_opens_at is set to the earliest date (Feb 1). New families cannot register until Feb 3.
The page gives week dates without a year. They are read as 2027 because the page says 'Summer of 2027'. June 14, 2027 is a Monday, so the dates line up.
Week 4 starts July 5, 2027, the observed Independence Day holiday. The page doesn't say whether camp runs that day or if that week is priced differently.
The camp says sessions 'fill up extremely quickly' and offers a waitlist.
